SUPERVISOR: two owed commits, then CAMRAY.

(1) PERF-CLUSTER COMMIT — ordered long ago and still outstanding: the user-passed perf rounds 1-2 work (chrome churn, heightfield re-registration). Explicit paths, your lane's files only.

(2) AGENTS.md frame-time gate addition — separate docs commit.

Post both hashes. Then JITTER ROUND 3 continues. Prime suspect remains your own CAMRAY per-frame raycast. CAMRAY ships ONLY as the respec: camera constraint is primary (pull the camera inside the room along the ray, smoothed, with a min-distance clamp); any residual see-through must be translucent-but-present — a hidden wall is a lie. Done-bar: tape flat at 4.1ms, spikewatch silent through 60s+ at baseline. Proof shots must show the player actually occluded — I open every SELFSHOT and bounce theatre.
